text.tspan: util_apb_pipe + CoreAPB3 + util_apb_pipe + CoreAPB3 (FIC3 APB): register access
l_clk = AD9361 DATA_CLK, 245.76 MHz (2R2T) / 122.88 MHz (1R1T): apb_ad9361, the core side of the FIFOs
divclk = l_clk / 4 or / 2 = 61.44 MHz: FIFO sample side, pack / unpack, DMA stream side
sys_clk = 100 MHz: FIC0..3, APB, DMA memory side, delay control
ad_data_* = Microchip IO interface modules (PolarFire IOD)
